decisions.reason: The metro data centre interconnect network showed concrete adoption by financial customers and sits at the core of the firm's high-bandwidth, carrier-neutral data centre strategy, so performance meets aspirations and nothing triggers problemistic search.

Optical spectrum service monetises the owned fibre with low incremental cost and is central to the high-bandwidth direction; the lack of website observations after 2019 is weak evidence of a shortfall.

The number ordering portal is a cheap self-service tool that supports real-time provisioning, so the expanding firm's slack lets it carry the portal even though it may be absorbed into a broader customer portal.

Direct voice connection remains part of the core enterprise voice offer, and despite declining legacy voice revenues and falling industry turnover there is no clear evidence that it falls below aspirations enough to justify reallocating its resources.
